name: make-it-real-creative-studio
title: Make It Real: From Prompt to Creative Studio
description: A 24-second journey from a single prompt to a playful creative studio. Crisp 2D controls meet a real 3D character, spatial camera moves, soundtrack-driven waveforms, a physical edit timeline, and a screen that plays the film itself. Includes the Hyperframes media composition and editable Blender/Python production sources. Native 1920×1080, 30fps; prerendered 3D, not a real-time WebGL scene.
